_note: One list holds every meeting, past and future, in any order. The website sorts them and works out which are upcoming by looking at the date; you never mark a meeting as past. date, time and title are required; note, agenda, minutes and location are optional. The location at the top applies to every meeting, unless a meeting carries its own location line. Add the agenda link when it is ready and the minutes link after the meeting. Agendas and minutes are for homeowners, so they live in the Portal: paste the Portal address and add "portal": true to that meeting. While no future meeting is listed, the website says the next meeting is to be announced.
location: Location to be confirmed by the board
